name: mace
why: The one-handed mace (gearlook.js PROC 'mace', every cleric's own and a paladin's), made by Tripo in place of the one procgear.js builds in code on the knight's sword mount.

image.prompt: Stylized low-poly fantasy one-handed flanged mace, a single game prop shown whole, standing perfectly upright and vertical with the head at the top, centered, seen from the side. Short sturdy wooden haft with a wrapped leather grip near the bottom and a round steel pommel. A big chunky steel head with six thick flanges and a rounded cap, a thin gold band where the head meets the haft. Chunky readable shapes, big head, hand-painted flat colours with soft light-to-dark gradients, no texture noise, no harsh shadows. Game-ready prop in the style of KayKit adventurers. Plain light grey background, nothing else in the picture. --no hands, character, text, multiple objects, spikes, chains
